features: Underfloor Heating Included in the Service Charge
Great Transport Links including Elizabeth Line
description_html:
Immaculate large style studio type F2A. 3 full height width floor to ceiling door/windows leading to a balcony/fire exit. Refurbished by the Thomson Bro’s. Generous storage. West facing located on the 2nd floor. Lift. Underfloor heating included in the service charge. Lift. Use of residents’ gardens. 24hr car park attendants can hold keys and receive packages. Car parking and bike storage by separate negotiation with the City of London. The Barbican Estate includes the Barbican Arts Centre, cinemas, art gallery, concert hall, theatre, restaurants, bars and cafes. Waitrose, Marks & Spencer and Tesco are close at hand. The Barbican is perfectly located for the Elizabeth Line, with both Farringdon and Liverpool Street stations only a short walk away. Also in close proximity to the various lines at underground stations Barbican, St. Paul’s, and Moorgate. No onward chain.
Service Charge: Estimated: £4,331 - 01/04/25 to 31/03/26.
Lease: 1st July 2196
